Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
From molecule_dictionary md
Join compound_records cr on md.molregno = cr.molregno
Join docs d on cr.doc_id = d.doc_id and d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697781'
Left Join compound_structures cs on md.molregno = cs.molregno
Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Sort by molecule_chembl_id
No distinct
